# Tethys

> Tethys is a DOE-funded knowledge platform providing comprehensive environmental data, monitoring tools, and research resources for wind and marine renewable energy development.

Tethys, developed by PNNL, serves as a central hub for environmental effects research and permitting guidance across offshore wind and marine energy sectors. The platform integrates metadata collections, interactive tools, educational resources, and international event calendars to support sustainable renewable energy deployment.

## Key Topics

- Marine Renewable Energy
- Offshore Wind
- Environmental Effects
- Environmental Monitoring
- OES-Environmental
- Risk Retirement
- Knowledge Base
- Metadata Collection
- WREN
- SEER
- Management Measures
- Environmental Assessment
- Renewable Energy
- Marine Energy Projects
- Educational Resources

## Core Platform & Overview

- [About Tethys](https://tethys.pnnl.gov/about-tethys): DOE-funded database on environmental effects of wind and marine renewable energy
- [About](https://tethys.pnnl.gov/about): Overview of Tethys platform and related projects: OES-Environmental, WREN, SEER
- [Content Hub](https://tethys.pnnl.gov/content): Main content hub: Knowledge Base, Map Viewer, Events Calendar, metadata collections

## Marine Energy Tools & Resources

- [MRE Tools](https://tethys.pnnl.gov/mre-tools): OES-Environmental tools: Risk Retirement, Evidence Bases, educational resources
- [Risk Retirement](https://tethys.pnnl.gov/risk-retirement): Process for identifying low-risk marine energy device interactions for permitting
- [Management Measures Tool for Marine Energy](https://tethys.pnnl.gov/management-measures): Mitigation technologies and alternatives for marine renewable energy impacts
- [Monitoring Datasets Discoverability Matrix](https://tethys.pnnl.gov/monitoring-datasets-discoverability-matrix): Interactive tool organizing marine renewable energy monitoring datasets by stressor

## Environmental Monitoring Data

- [Marine Energy Environmental Monitoring Metadata](https://tethys.pnnl.gov/marine-energy-metadata): OES-Environmental marine renewable energy project database with monitoring data
- [Offshore Wind Environmental Monitoring Metadata](https://tethys.pnnl.gov/offshore-wind-metadata): Global offshore wind farm environmental effects data and monitoring information

## Wind Energy Tools & Resources

- [Wind Tools](https://tethys.pnnl.gov/wind-tools): WREN/SEER tools: monitoring technologies, research projects, regulatory frameworks

## Education & Outreach

- [Marine Renewable Energy Educational Resources](https://tethys.pnnl.gov/marine-renewable-energy-educational-resources): STEM materials on marine energy environmental effects and ocean science topics
- [Marine Energy Social and Economic Data Collection Toolkit](https://tethys.pnnl.gov/marine-energy-social-economic-data-collection-toolkit): Toolkit with template and metrics for marine energy socioeconomic data collection
- [Events Calendar for Wind and Marine Energy](https://tethys.pnnl.gov/events): International events calendar for wind and marine renewable energy conferences

## Contribution & Community

- [Contributing to Tethys](https://tethys.pnnl.gov/contributing-tethys): Guide for submitting documents, research, and project data to Tethys database
